reviews.author: Maya Puseljic
reviews.text: I have been going here for 15 years and my whole family uses Bill's. I wouldn't go anywhere else. I am a life long customer and anyone who goes here once becomes a lifelong customer. I highly recommend them. They are honest and won't over sell you. They work with your needs and make appropriate recommendations for any vehicle they service.

reviews.author: Cora Koehler DiDomenico
reviews.text: Justin was amazing to work with. He was clear and concise with his diagnosis of the work my car needed. He wasn’t pushy and there was no mansplaining. I felt confident with his rate. He was timely and communicated throughout the day while my vehicle was being worked on. I will 100% be bringing our entire family’s fleet of vehicles here and no where else going forward. I had a standard oil change, tire rotation, and body work done on my van’s front bumper. He genuinely cares about his customers as well as his employees. Don’t think twice, save your vehicle and your headache and head over to Bill’s Ineffable Auto!

reviews.author: Terry Wooding
reviews.text: Justin, Rick and their team are very knowledgeable. You can trust their diagnosis. They will review with you your car's needs before doing any work and will provide a thorough explanation of work done upon pickup. You can trust that your car maintenance and repair will be done right.

reviews.author: Stephen Von Ohlen
reviews.text: Best repair shop in Central New Jersey. I drive 10 miles for their expertise. My recently retired Scion went 245000 miles without a major repair with all service done at Bill’s. Rust killed it and Justin will let you know when it’s time not spend money on a vehicle.

reviews.author: Ali Tango
reviews.text: I trust this place above almost any other shop. Justin is a straight up SAINT. They will never overcharge or perform extra services just for an up charge. Super reliable and they do great work.

reviews.author: Jonathan Castellano
reviews.text: I've been going to Bill's Ineffable for years now. Best mechanic I've ever come across! They are highly trained, professional, and helpful. Every time I go, they teach me something new about cars. They explain the problem and solution in detail, as well as a complete workup on any other issues I may have overlooked. I do a lot of my own work on cars, and sometimes Justin will tell me "You can do this one yourself." These guys charge more than your typical shop, but their work is high-quality and you can leave with confidence.

reviews.author: Kenneth Vercammen Esq. Edison
reviews.text: Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehab did a great job repairing issues on my Ford Escape. We have used Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehab and owner Justin for all our repair work. We trust him. As a community minded businessperson, I have a commitment to patronize local businesses. Consumers in Central Jersey appreciate local business people, such as you, who devote substantial effort to customer satisfaction. We appreciate your willingness to provide excellent service at a cost-effective price. I would highly recommend you to my clients and business friends. Keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Montana Barone
reviews.text: Our family has been going to Bill's Ineffable for years and we absolutely love them! Everyone is knowledgeable, honest, helpful, respectful, and caring.... truly the list goes on and on. Finding a good mechanic isn't easy. But, Justin and Rich are both excellent mechanics that you can trust. It is not just the quality of their work that has left me so impressed time and time again, it's how they have treated our family as customers. I feel comfortable going in by myself, and they have been absolutely incredible when I needed to bring along one of my kids (one of which has special needs). I'm not a car person but I always feel like they talk to me, not down to me, and help me to understand what is going on with my vehicle. And, I have never left feeling like I was taken advantage of or that they were trying to convince me to do something unnecessary to "pad" a bill. Whether it is a quick fix like needing air in my tire or more extensive work like when they re-did my brakes, they have taken the same level of care and attention, and ensured my vehicle is safe for our family. Really, what more can you ask for?

reviews.author: Eddie Rokosz
reviews.text: I don't usually write reviews, but on rare occasions I am inspired by a business that just consistently doesn't disappoint. Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehab is one of those rare establishments, and the only place we take our vehicles. We have been going there for years, and have never been disappointed by Justin and his team. Justin is a consummate professional, and just a genuinely good person. He is extremely respectful, honest, and thorough. If you are looking for an established auto shop that is trustworthy, and will get the job done properly, then look no further.

reviews.author: Bryan Horowitz
reviews.text: I can't say enough about Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehab, easily the best mechanic I've ever gone to, and not just because they're excellent at fixing cars (which they are). Justin and Rich don't always necessarily tell you what you want to hear, but they tell you what you NEED to hear. My wife and I have two kids we absolutely cherish, and their safety is paramount to us. We've had situations where we go to Bill's hoping a little rattle requires a quick fix or something, and then we end up needing more work than we expected. But we love that they tell us exactly what's wrong and don't sugar coat anything. They also won't do anything that DOESN'T need to be done, a problem I've experienced with other mechanics. In addition, we're actually going to be in the market for a new car soon, and Justin has been counseling us on everything: What brand he trusts, what dealership he prefers and when we should take the plunge price-wise. He's also a pleasure to talk to, as is everyone else we've dealt with at Bill's. And he supplied a couple of tires for a birthday party we had for our son at the house. Basically, if you're looking for someone to placate you or put a band-aid on an axe wound, this is not your place. Best of luck to you. If you instead want the best mechanic in the business who specializes in doing what it takes to keep you and your family safe, look no further. We are proud customers and will be for years to come.

reviews.author: Dan Cea
reviews.text: The best and only place I will take my car. Justin (Bill is the name of the old owner) has been keeping my car running for 10+ years now. He is EXTREMELY trustworthy. He never does unnecessary work. He will let you know what needs to be addressed, and at what date. The whole staff is very friendly. Their description of what needs to be done is very straight forward and easy to understand.

reviews.author: Etan Goldberg
reviews.text: Trust Justin and his team 100%. Professional with a capital P. Amazing service, clean, knowledgeable and trustworthy. He helped me navigate greedy dealerships and guided me in good decisions. Have never had mechanic I trust as much as the team at Bills Ineffable Auto.

reviews.author: Dayana Perez
reviews.text: The most amazing service! Bill is definitely an expert in his field and he so eloquently explains everything! Highly professional! Come here for your auto needs! He is the very best !

reviews.author: ALLEYCVTz
reviews.text: This place is perfect and I wish I had gone to them sooner. I’ve never been to an auto repair place with a more caring and thorough team than this one. When they write out your diagnosis report/bill to pay they give you the most thorough summary of exactly what they performed on your car, what it means, and what the best course of action is going forward. They will verbally summarize it for you as well if you have any questions while reading the paperwork. No repair place is going to be dirt cheap, but you can at least expect 100% genuineness in their work and actually get your moneys worth - instead of going to other places that will screw you over again and again and suck your wallet dry. This is the only place I’ll be taking my Hyundai Elantra to from now on. Thank you.

reviews.author: Stephan Bennett
reviews.text: Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehabilitation is a skilled and trustworthy garage. Justin has been our mechanic for 14 years and I have never had a complaint. He is honest and detailed about what your car needs, and goes the extra mile to get it done. There is no better mechanic in the area.

reviews.author: Kaila Nichol
reviews.text: I wouldn’t bring my car anywhere else. My family and I have been coming here for years. Justin and the staff are fantastic. It’s not just an oil change, they check the car top to bottom and let you know if any maintenance, routine or otherwise, is needed. They genuine care for you and your vehicle; this is certainly a business you can trust.

reviews.author: Rich Tomchuk
reviews.text: Justin is a good man and a rare honest mechanic. His team does great work. Your car will be in good hands here.

reviews.author: thabigski
reviews.text: I can’t speak on the quality of the auto service/crew themselves since we opted not to use them after dealing with the front desk salesman What initially appears to be a honest and reliable service center quickly revealed itself to be an incredible hassle by a crook. They do a good job of detailing all the work a car needs, as should any mechanic. However we just wanted to get some minor work done at the time. When it became apparent to them we weren’t willing to spend 5 thousand dollars, the tone changed. We had difficulty getting the car back from them to take elsewhere. They then tried to convince us we needed to junk the car with them (that has since been fixed for a couple hundred and running great!) for 500$. After which he continued to call us and tried to get us to bring another car in for them to look at. If a guy wants to go into a long winded speech about how they aren’t here to rob you, and you can trust them when he first meets with you, maybe that should pose some red flags about the type of person you will be dealing with.

reviews.author: David cruz
reviews.text: I will be telling my adult children that this is the the only shop they should consider for all of their automotive maintenance and repairs. Being in my sixties, rest assured I've used all the options for auto repair, self repair, private owned shops, corporate chains and dealer service. Bill's Ineffable Auto Rehab is as different from all the above as the name implies. Justin and Rich treat each customer with respect and put you at ease when speaking to you about your particular situation. They are as knowledgeable as you would expect any automotive technician to be. Where they differ is in how they share that information with the customer. My particular repair was extensive and having the information at the very onset of what would be involved made it clear to me that I was in the right shop. I will try my best to forgo the "easy" and quick maintenance of the above mentioned alternatives to using Bill's, as I want to do my part to insure that this auto repair shop has the customer base to continue on and hopefully repair my grandchildren's EV's and Hovercraft!

reviews.author: Koga Namgyal
reviews.text: They did an inspection and told me my brake pads needed changing, even though I recently changed them. I later verified that the brake pads are at >70%, meaning they won't need changing for a few years. Decided to get my car fixed elsewhere.

reviews.author: James A. Foley
reviews.text: The honest mechanic everyone needs. There are less expensive places to get automotive maintenance and repair work done, but you get a level of service, time, and attention at Bill's Ineffable that makes it worth the premium. Taking my car elsewhere just feels irresponsible.

reviews.author: T Maze
reviews.text: Everytime my car is serviced here Justin breaks down everything explains in great detail. Also they do not just fix a problem they advise you first so u can decide to go ahead and start fixing it. Most places will find, fix, charge leaving ppl no choice but to pay even if it is way out of their price range.

reviews.author: Derek McConnell
reviews.text: I had my 2018 BMW X3 serviced here a few months back. We needed brake pads/calipers replaced and some other minor maintenance items taken care of. Service was completed quickly, but more importantly done correctly and with true OEM parts instead of knock-offs like you'll get at many other shops. If you want your vehicle taken care of by true professionals who care about how your it's treated while it's in their hands, by all means use this shop.

reviews.author: Edward Pierce
reviews.text: Justin is great. We have a 2011 Toyota Venza that had a humming noise coming from the front driver's wheel. Diagnosis was quick and seamless and the work was done on time. Awesome!

reviews.author: Kassim Chaudry
reviews.text: Consumate and personable professionals who care about their customers and aim for excellence in all repairs and recommendations. Always clearly explain the necessary and perhaps secondary fixes that may be less urgent. Highly recommended with no reservation.

reviews.author: Lorri Lindsay
reviews.text: There is no better shop in Central NJ. Justin and his crew actually care about keeping my car running as smooth and safe as the day it rolled off the assembly line.

reviews.author: Scott Bourne
reviews.text: Our family has been using Bill's Auto for years. Great people and great service. We cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Godspeedmax
reviews.text: Best mechanic place I ever been to. The honesty they show is jaw dropping. Comprehensive car care. Love Justin and those dogs!

reviews.author: Matthew LaPine
reviews.text: I was so pleased with my first experience at Bill's. I wasn't talked down to; I was treated with respect. Plus, my car was repaired perfectly THE FIRST TIME!

reviews.author: David Berkley
reviews.text: Bill's is the rare repair shop that pays attention to details and provides full information to the car owner. They are not the least expensive but I am left feeling they are worth it!

reviews.author: Charles Lynn
reviews.text: They are very meticulous in their work, and take pride in their excellence! They took the time to explain what was wrong and how they would fix it. I'd give them more stars if it were allowed!

reviews.author: William Hopkins
reviews.text: These guys really know their stuff. Straight answers to your questions and great service. Justin is great to work with anything automotive.

reviews.author: Beverly Deutschman
reviews.text: Great place for car care. Knowledgeable techs and just over all great. I'd recommend this place to anyone and I have.

reviews.author: louise keating
reviews.text: They are outstanding !!!! Very honest .....myself ,my mother and my daughter use Bills. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe Churilla
reviews.text: Thoughtful, competent and professional advice. Affordable service. Only my first visit here but I don't expect it to be the last.

reviews.author: D. Donovan
reviews.text: No BS, they are the best a business can be. They are intelligent and knowledgeable, extremely friendly, and a fantastic bargain.
